seo.title: Lightly Distressed Limestone Pavers & Stone Flooring
seo.description: Eco Outdoor provides the best in Lightly Distressed Limestone pavers and flooring for your project. Find resources, request a sample or contact a rep today.

content.value: These lightly distressed limestone tiles have clean lines, sawn edges and tight grout joints giving them a contemporary look and feel. Ideal for those who want to achieve a modern aesthetic but still want some of that texture and earthiness inherent in natural stone.
